name: radiance_construct
notes: Hard holy light in the Construct's starlight: a near-upright white blade 86 px tall edged in its cyan, an afterimage edge, hard 1 px star rays flickering on twos at three heights, long light shafts streaming back, star glints, a faint glare line on the floor. No blur. Chest-high: roll through it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 90; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 59; place that point on the ring's position.
